    theorem ZFib.External.OperatorAlgebra.RelTensor.gram_posSemidef {A : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [CStarAlgebra A] [PartialOrder A] [StarOrderedRing A] [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℂ E] [SMul A E] [Norm E] [CStarModule A E] {I : Type u_3} [Fintype I] (e : I → E) :
    Matrix.PosSemidef fun (i j : I) => inner A (e j) (e i)

    The Gram matrix in the orientation delivered by cstarModule_gram_quadratic_nonneg.

    For Mathlib's CStarModule convention, the quadratic form attached to Matrix.PosSemidef is sum_i sum_j star (x i) * M i j * x j, so the committed lemma feeds the coefficient matrix M i j = inner A (e j) (e i).
